not_measured.reason: peak build RSS is the maximum over 100 ms samples of the summed RSS of the whole build process tree (shared pages are double counted); a sampled lower bound of the true instantaneous peak
headless Xvfb with software rendering (llvmpipe/--disable-gpu); not comparable to real hardware

not_measured.metric: Network-dependent ops (T7 / DXVK / Enhanced downloads, update-check)
not_measured.reason: excluded from headline numbers; run with --phases ...,network
window is polled via xdotool every ~20 ms; the reported value is the first poll that saw a viewable window >=200x150, so it has ~20-40 ms granularity
launch-options / workshop-install / enhanced-uninstall / reset-stock block on a fake `steam` client (5 s sleep + >=2 s stability poll in the legacy code); they are tagged and reported separately
